text.tspan: Reading the input from right to left places duplicate keys in their original relative order.
This backward pass guarantees that Counting Sort is STABLE.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Scanning input from right to left preserves the original relative order of equal items (stability).
